te zullen overhoopgooien
overhoop te zullen gooien

glosses: op heftige wijze voorwerpen door elkaar smijten

examples.text: Zij gooide al haar spullen overhoop en ging op de bank zitten janken.

translations.source_sense_description: op heftige wijze voorwerpen door elkaar smijten
op heftige wijze voorwerpen door elkaar smijten

glosses: To flip over; to rotate top to bottom.

examples.text: Turn the box upside down and look at the bottom.
They turned the house upside down looking for the car keys.

glosses: To alter (something) significantly, often in a negative way.

examples.text: Rio Ferdinand will almost certainly miss out on Euro 2004, and possibly much more, because of the missed drug test which has turned his life upside down.
